# Module Name

Brief description of what this module creates.

## Usage

```hcl
module "example" {
  source = "../modules/example"

  name = "my-resource"
  tags = {
    Environment = "production"
    ManagedBy   = "terraform"
  }
}
```

## Requirements

| Name | Version |
|------|---------|
| terraform | >= 1.6 |

## Inputs

<!-- Generated by terraform-docs: terraform-docs markdown table . -->

| Name | Description | Type | Default | Required |
|------|-------------|------|---------|:--------:|
| name | Name for the resource | `string` | n/a | yes |
| tags | Tags to apply to all resources | `map(string)` | `{}` | no |

## Outputs

| Name | Description |
|------|-------------|
| id | The ID of the created resource |
